name: DLSS5 Geode
description: RTX-inspired cinematic visual effects for Geometry Dash: animated player aura, energy trails, light shafts, color grading and mobile quality profiles.

visual-title.name: DLSS5 Visual Engine
visual-title.description: Cinematic rendering-inspired visual engine for Android.

enabled.name: Enable visual effects
enabled.description: Turns the visual filter on or off during gameplay.

intensity.name: Effect intensity
intensity.description: Controls color grading, bloom-style lift and vignette strength.

color-style.name: Color profile
color-style.description: Choose the overall color tone of the visual filter.

quality.name: Graphics quality
quality.description: Choose the visual workload. Ultra enables the fullest aura and light-shaft effects; use Balanced or Performance if frame rate drops.

player-aura.name: Player aura and highlights
player-aura.description: Adds additive glow rings and a bright rim streak around visible players.

light-rays.name: Volumetric-style light shafts
light-rays.description: Adds subtle animated light beams in the background.
